question: Can the exact production bilateral c_proj chart lower full student LM CE from the terminal plain-cproj endpoint when every learned base parameter is frozen?
scientific_scope: causal task-conditioned endpoint optimization; chart-only diagnostic, not continued pretraining and not a deployable selection result

rationale.teacher_endpoint_oracle_result: The chart recovered 72.3924 percent of held-out teacher MLP-output error on average, but every single fitted layer worsened complete-model CE and the all-layer insertion worsened holdout CE by 5.69498.
rationale.causal_gap: Teacher-output reconstruction is therefore not a valid task direction in the separately co-adapted student residual frame.
rationale.required_test: Optimize the same chart directly against student next-token CE while freezing every base parameter.

chart.implementation: exact production cached bilateral c_proj chart in all 12 layers

optimization_protocol.updated_parameters: only the four exact chart groups in every layer; all checkpoint parameters and generated BlockFHT bases are frozen
optimization_protocol.objective: next-token cross entropy on deterministic fresh train.bin windows
optimization_protocol.learning_rate_rationale: The initially registered 0.00072 joint-training chart LR was rejected before the scientific run: the exact five-update preflight moved subsequent deterministic-batch CE from the zero-update range 5.7034-5.7728 to 6.3805-7.6497. Frozen-endpoint optimization moves all twelve charts without base co-adaptation, so the amended LR is a preregistered tenfold trust reduction, not a validation-selected sweep.

evaluation_protocol.data_split: val.bin only; no validation window participates in optimization
evaluation_protocol.selection: choose the registered evaluation update with lowest primary validation CE, then report the untouched confirmation-seed CE at that same update

decision_rule.positive_task_capacity: the primary-selected chart state improves both primary and confirmation validation CE by at least 0.005 versus the identity state
decision_rule.optimization_only_signal: training CE improves but the registered validation rule does not pass
decision_rule.reject_bilateral_chart: the registered validation rule does not pass; close the bilateral chart family and test a jointly learned narrow residual/MLP frame

performance_gate.measurement: same script, model, chart, batch shape, accumulation, cache path, optimizer, and GPU as the scientific run
performance_gate.numerator: conventional 6N decoder-model FLOP estimate times measured tokens per second
performance_gate.denominator: same-GPU empirical BF16 tensor-core GEMM peak

stability_control.separation: this calibration seed is distinct from both scientific primary and confirmation validation seeds

rejected_preflight.decision: performance passed, optimization safety failed; no scientific run launched

performance_gate.policy: foreground poll the preflight; do not start the scientific run unless both the immutable 20 percent MFU gate and separate-seed CE safety gate pass

required_artifacts: chart-only states at every registered evaluation update
